headline: cybersecurity-tips rises 59 to 64; remote-work-digital-nomad falls 66 to 62
paragraphs: Biggest score moves since yesterday: cybersecurity-tips rose from 59 to 64 as its breakout rate went from 31% to 36%; remote-work-digital-nomad fell from 66 to 62 (38% to 32%). horror-stories rose from 72 to 74; unsolved-mysteries fell from 85 to 83.

In true-crime the typical best outlier rose from 12.3x to 17.1x. In unsolved-mysteries, 9 of the top 12 videos are in Hindi or Sinhala, so English demand is unclear. In cybersecurity-tips, 6 of the top 12 are off-topic or not in English.

Notable outliers: Amelia Revenge Stories at 353.8x in reddit-stories (79,243 views, 1,140 subscribers) and Dreamnest Frames at 225.7x in disasters (280,937 views, 10,000 subscribers). No niches added today. Thumbnails not viewable; titles only.
